title: More useful geography recaps and guides
body:
- Past country recaps now include catalog-backed candidate narrowing, comparisons with recorded wrong guesses, and a read-only map highlighting the target and mapped wrong guesses.
- Recap articles avoid repeating their introductions and distinguish recorded game answers from verified geographical facts.
- Corrected geography guidance and county elimination percentages.
- The daily country game now provides readable rules, question and guess limits, and help links before JavaScript loads.
